cases.name: tampered-entry-bundle
cases.says: one byte of one entry changed: the bundle still frames, and the tree it builds is not the one the checkpoint is signed over

cases.name: missing-entry-bundle
cases.says: a log that will not serve its entries cannot be replayed, and a verifier must refuse rather than report what it has

comment: a served log is a directory, so each case names the path to replace with `file` or to delete with `remove`, over an otherwise honest copy of `served/`. Every one MUST be refused
